products.name: 2MP Full-Color HD Analog Bullet Camera
products.title: 2MP Full-Color HD Analog Bullet Camera
products.description: Capture clear, detailed footage with 1080P real-time imaging and true-to-life color. Designed for day-and-night surveillance, this camera supports 24/7 full-color imaging with built-in LED illumination covering a distance of 10–20 metres. Progressive-scan CMOS technology captures moving subjects, while noise reduction helps improve image clarity. With AHD, TVI, CVI, and 960H CVBS output support, the camera offers flexibility for compatible surveillance systems. Its IP67-rated housing provides protection against dust and water for indoor and outdoor installations.
keyFeatures: 1080P Full HD Imaging: High-resolution, real-time video with accurate color reproduction.
Multiple Video Outputs: Supports AHD, TVI, and CVI lossless HD video output, plus 960H CVBS output.
Up to 1000 TVL: Supports analog resolution of up to 1000 TV lines.
Progressive-Scan CMOS Sensor: Captures moving subjects with clear image detail.
24/7 Full-Color Imaging: Maintains color visibility day and night with LED illumination.
10–20 m LED Range: Provides supplemental lighting for nearby monitoring areas.
Automatic LED Control: LEDs switch on or off automatically according to lighting conditions.
Noise Reduction: Helps reduce image noise for cleaner footage.
OSD Menu: Allows adjustment of supported camera settings through an on-screen menu.
Real-Time Transmission: Supports high-speed video transmission over long distances.
Coaxial Audio Transmission: Supports audio transmission over compatible coaxial connections.
Control over Coax (COC): Allows supported camera settings to be controlled through a compatible recorder.
IP67 Protection: Dust-tight housing with protection against temporary immersion in water.

products.name: 2MP Full-Color HD Analog Turret Camera
products.title: 2MP Full-Color HD Analog Turret Camera
products.description: Monitor your property with clear 1080P real-time video and true-to-life colors. Featuring a progressive-scan CMOS sensor and noise reduction, this camera captures detailed footage of moving subjects while helping reduce image noise. Supporting AHD, TVI, CVI, and 960H CVBS outputs, it offers flexible connectivity with compatible surveillance systems. A 10–20 metre infrared night-vision range supports monitoring in darkness, while its IP67-rated housing makes it suitable for indoor and outdoor installations.
keyFeatures: 1080P Full HD Video: High-resolution, real-time imaging with accurate colors.
Multiple Output Formats: Supports AHD, TVI, and CVI HD video outputs, plus 960H CVBS.
Up to 1000 TVL: Supports analog resolution of up to 1000 TV lines.
Progressive-Scan CMOS Sensor: Captures moving subjects with clear detail.
Full-Color Imaging: Supports color surveillance when sufficient ambient or visible supplemental light is available.
10–20 m IR Night Vision: Provides infrared visibility in low-light and dark environments.
Automatic LED Control: Supports automatic LED switching.
Noise Reduction: Helps deliver cleaner images with reduced visual noise.
OSD Menu: Provides access to supported camera image settings.
Long-Distance Transmission: Supports high-speed, real-time video transmission.
Coaxial Audio Support: Transmits audio over compatible coaxial connections.
Control over Coax (COC): Adjust supported camera settings through a compatible recorder.
IP67-Rated Housing: Provides dust and water protection for outdoor use.
